title: Geometry-Preserving Neural Architectures on Manifolds with Boundary
abstract: arXiv:2602.03082v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A growing number of neural architectures have been developed to enforce geometric constraints, including projection-based networks, exponential-map updates, and manifold neural ODEs. In this paper, we study several such architectures, with the goal of understanding their approximation-theoretic properties and trade-offs. We distinguish between architectures that enforce constraints at intermediate layers and those that enforce constraints only at the output. For projected neural ODEs on uniformly prox-regular sets, we establish stability estimates and derive universal approximation results on compact smooth manifolds, including manifolds with boundary. In particular, we establish universal approximation of measurable manifold-valued maps in the $L^2$ topology. In contrast, architectures that enforce constraints only at the output can admit uniform approximation guarantees for continuous target maps under suitable geometric assumption

translated_title: 带边界流形上的保几何神经架构
translated_abstract: 越来越多的神经架构被开发用于强制执行几何约束，包括基于投影的网络、指数映射更新以及流形神经常微分方程（neural ODEs）。本文研究了若干此类架构，旨在理解其逼近论性质与权衡。我们区分了在中间层强制执行约束的架构与仅在输出端强制执行约束的架构。对于一致近点正则集上的投影神经常微分方程，我们建立了稳定性估计，并在紧致光滑流形（包括带边界的流形）上导出了万能逼近结果。特别地，我们在 $L^2$ 拓扑下建立了对可测流形值映射的万能逼近。相比之下，仅在输出端强制执行约束的架构在适当的几何假设下可以对连续目标映射给出一致逼近保证。
tldr: 本文系统研究了几类保持几何约束的神经架构的逼近论性质，证明了一致近点正则集上投影神经ODE在含边界紧致光滑流形上的稳定性估计与可测流形值映射的 $L^2$ 万能逼近定理，并揭示了中间层约束与仅输出端约束两类架构在逼近保证上的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the approximation-theoretic properties of geometry-preserving neural architectures, establishing stability estimates and universal approximation of measurable manifold-valued maps in the $L^2$ topology for projected neural ODEs on compact smooth manifolds with boundary, while contrasting architectures enforcing constraints at intermediate layers with those enforcing them only at the output.
